push.title: L 1-2 vs Sovereign XII | You: 8.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.5 against Sovereign XII. I'd give that a gold star if I could find my sticker book.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at Sovereign XII's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You threaded the needle and stitched up a chance.
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 3. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ On-ball actions 43, up from your usual 31. Bottle that and bring it next match.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 6 on target. Here's the play: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle. Trust me on that one.
- Won 1 of 7 tackles (down from your usual 61%). For next time: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
- Pass accuracy: 86%. Next target: 88%+.
- A one-goal loss (1-2): a single moment decided it. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. A team result, and it needs a team answer.

This week's homework: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

BellyTb1, from me to you: Kindness costs nothing and wins locker rooms.

I'm proud as a peacock. - Coach Lasso
